title: Unique multiplicity-one tangents at first surface-flow singularities
exact_target: For a smooth compact connected embedded surface without boundary in $R^{3}$, must the full family of parabolic rescalings at every singular point of the first maximal smooth mean-curvature-flow time converge, in the original coordinates and locally smoothly with multiplicity one at all negative times, to one smooth properly embedded self-shrinker flow?
